summary.text: Conrad Cable is a farmer from north Louisiana running as a Democratic candidate for Louisiana's 4th Congressional District. He describes himself as a first-generation farmer and is campaigning on Medicare for All, food security and campaign-finance reform.

paragraphs.text: Grew up in Union Parish and has lived in Louisiana his entire life; his campaign website says he grew up in the town of Marion.
Graduated from Ouachita Christian School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisiana at Monroe in 2017.
Describes himself as a first-generation farmer: after losing his job during COVID, he and his brother built a small farm in Union Parish, and he now runs a vegetable farm with his brother in Marion.
Says his decision to run was shaped by the closure of his childhood school after funding cuts and by the Citizens United ruling.
